rules.label: Visa waiver (NZeTA): up to 3 months per visit

limitsByNationality.label: Visa waiver (NZeTA): up to 6 months per visit for British citizens

notes: Most visa waiver visitors can stay up to 3 months per visit, and British citizens up to 6 months. The app uses the limit for your passport.
You need an NZeTA before you travel. It can't be extended: to stay longer, apply for a visitor visa.
Visitor visa holders can usually spend up to 9 months in any 18 months in New Zealand.
Australian citizens can live and work in New Zealand without a visa.

rules.label: More than 183 days in any 12 months
notes: Part days count as whole days, and the days don't need to be in a row.
Once you pass 183 days, you're treated as resident from the first of those days.
Having a permanent place of abode in New Zealand makes you resident however few days you spend there.
